series.title: ARCADE TRIBUTE - TOP SPEED
series.description: TAITO, 1987, called Full Throttle in Japan. A red sports car across America in five stages, roads forking halfway through, and a nitro button for bursts past 400 km/h.

series.title: ARCADE TRIBUTE - CONTINENTAL CIRCUS
series.description: TAITO, 1987. Formula One around eight Grands Prix of the world, seen in true 3D through shutter glasses hung over the cabinet: billed as the world's first 3D racing game.

series.title: ARCADE TRIBUTE - CHASE H.Q.
series.description: TAITO, 1988. Two undercover cops in a black turbo sports car, a call from headquarters, and sixty seconds to run a criminal down and ram his car to a stop. Five cases in all.

series.title: ARCADE TRIBUTE - BIG RUN
series.description: JALECO, 1989. The Paris-Dakar rally from Tripoli to Dakar, over desert, savanna and swamp, in a car like the 1986 winner, against the clock on every leg.

series.title: ARCADE TRIBUTE - CISCO HEAT
series.description: JALECO, 1990. A police car race through San Francisco: squad cars flying over its hills and around its corners, past the Golden Gate, with taxis, trams and fire engines in the way.
